description: Decode a Solana custom program error or JSON-RPC server error from a hex code (0x1771), decimal code (6001), a line such as 'custom program error: 0x1771', a JSON-RPC code such as -32002, or a full program log. Returns every known program that defines that code, or a single exact match when a program id or slug is given, plus the Rugsight Solana Error Codes page URL. Free, no payment, no RPC, no API key. Same data as GET /api/errors/decode?q={error}&program={program_id}. Use when you have a failed transaction error, a program log, or a code and need the name, message and the /errors page for it.

error.description: Error text, log excerpt, hex (0x1771), decimal code (6001), 'custom program error: 0x1771', a JSON-RPC code such as -32002, or a full log line.

program_id.description: Optional Solana program id (base58) or Rugsight program slug (e.g. jupiter-v6) that raised the error. Narrows the match when the same code is used by more than one program.

name: decode_solana_error
title: Decode a Solana program or JSON-RPC error (free)
